attributes.name: Unstable Accelerant
attributes.powers:
Display this barrier faceup next to your location; the barrier is defeated.

While displayed, when a character at this location plays a boon, each other character who can play a boon of the same type does so. When a character at that location rolls a die, treat odd rolls as 1 and even rolls as the highest number on that die.

When that location deck has no cards remaining, banish this barrier.
